**Senior Manager, Demand Generation Automation & Marketing Operations**

**Imagine the What. Build the How.**

Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows and provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

**Overview**

Scalable, efficient demand creation is a critical priority for our DG strategy. As AI and automation technologies are transforming how modern software companies approach demand generation, Scandit needs dedicated ownership to operationalise these tools and integrate them into our systems, processes and model.

We are seeking a strategic leader to sit at the critical intersection of Demand Generation, Sales and Marketing/Rev Ops teams to create, own and optimize the systems, processes, and integrations that power our inbound and demand generation engine. The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and curious about how AI and automation can improve process speed, accuracy, and operational efficiency.

**Your opportunity**

The Senior Manager, Demand Generation Automation & Marketing Operations will own our functional architecture and lead the transition toward an AI-augmented outbound engine. You won't just manage systems; you will be a change agent responsible for defining the operational standards that amplify our marketing impact and drive efficiencies in how we go to market.

The mission: Your immediate focus will be to build a scalable, autonomous machine that handles the end-to-end inbound nurture cycle while surfacing high-intent accounts to our BDR team and automating outreach. Beyond the technical build, you will lead the strategic roadmap for workflow automation, influencing stakeholders to adopt modern outreach methodologies. As this system matures, your mandate will expand to include identifying broader operational efficiencies across our DG tech stack and marketing operations workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

- **AI & Automation Roadmap:** Design and lead the transition toward an AI-augmented outbound engine and automating the end-to-end inbound nurture cycle. Build a scalable, autonomous machine that surfaces high-intent accounts to sales development reps and automates routine outreach tasks.
- **AI Orchestration & Governance:** Design and govern the "logic" behind AI-driven personalization, including prompt engineering and agentic workflows. You will lead the QA of AI-generated outputs to ensure they maintain Scandit’s brand voice, while managing the lifecycle of automated agents used for account research, lead enrichment, and meeting preparation. Ensure reliability, deliverability, and compliance with GDPR, brand standards, and email best practices. Consistently monitor domain reputation management.
- **Systems Integration**: Architect the tech stack required to power an autonomous demand engine. You will lead the business case for new tools and ensure the underlying "signal-to-action" infrastructure (connecting CRM, MAP, and AI) is clean, scalable, and highly integrated.
- **Experimentation & Optimisation**: Run controlled tests to continuously improve workflows. Systematically measure the business impact, monitoring metrics like conversion rates, pipe-to-spend and ROI of the strategies you build.
- **Enablement & Adoption**: Socialize and scale new processes across the Demand Gen and Sales teams. Create clear handoff and ownership to the sales development function for priority leads and accounts. Influence stakeholders to adopt modern outreach methodologies and drive the cultural shift toward automation-first operations.

**Who You Are**

- **10+ years of Marketing Operations experience** and experience leading direct reports.
- **Technical Proficiency**: Hands-on experience with tools like Salesforce, Marketo/HubSpot, Gong, Enrichment Providers, and modern "modern growth stack" tools (e.g., Clay, Zapier/Make, Relevance AI, Hockeystack/Dreamdata, or Lavender). Experience with LLM orchestration or agentic workflows.
- **AI Practitioner**: Comfortable with LLM orchestration, token management, and the "Human-in-the-Loop" QA processes required to keep AI outputs high-quality and on-brand. You have deep curiosity and practical understanding of how AI tools can be operationalized to improve marketing impact.
- **Compliance Minded:** You are rigorous about data privacy (GDPR), email deliverability standards, and maintaining a high bar for "human-sounding" personalization that doesn't feel like spam.
- **Growth Mindset**: Strong testing/experimentation orientation, you focus on measurable outcomes.
- **Collaboration**: Ability to act as the “bridge” between technical operations and Marketing.

**The good stuff** Here are just some of the reasons why people choose to build their career at Scandit:

- We are certified as a **“Great Place to Work”** in 7 countries!
- Smart, people-first culture
- Flexible, office, hybrid or home working
- Innovation hackathons
- Global team outings
- Festive/end of year all company celebrations
- Your birthday off
- Learning and development opportunities
- An attractive individual equity plan in a high growth company
- Top notch tech pack to enable you to do your most productive work
- Brand new optimized-for-hybrid working HQ in Zurich as well as local offices in hotspots London, Tampere, Warsaw, Boston and Tokyo
- As well as specific benefits related to the location you are joining
